claims.text: For \(t\in\mathbb Z\), let \(P(t)=0\) if \(t<0\), and, for \(t=6u+r\ge0\) with \(0\le r<6\), set \[ P(t)= \begin{cases} 3u^2+3u+1,&r=0,\\ 3u^2+4u+1,&r=1,\\ 3u^2+5u+2,&r=2,\\ 3u^2+6u+3,&r=3,\\ 3u^2+7u+4,&r=4,\\ 3u^2+8u+5,&r=5. \end{cases} \] Then \(P(t)=\#\{\lambda:\ell(\lambda)\le3,\ |\lambda|=t\}\).

For \(b\ge1\), put \(R_b(N)=\#\{\rho\subseteq b^3:|\rho|=N\}\). Its complete piecewise quasi-polynomial formula is \[ R_b(N)= \begin{cases} 0,&N<0\text{ or }N>3b,\\[2pt] P(N),&0\le N\le b,\\[2pt] P(N)-P(N-b-1)-P(N-b-2)-P(N-b-3), &b<N\le\lfloor3b/2\rfloor,\\[2pt] R_b(3b-N),&\lfloor3b/2\rfloor<N\le3b. \end{cases} \]
The complement \(\rho^\vee=(b-\rho_3,b-\rho_2,b-\rho_1)\) is an involution of partitions in \(b^3\) and gives \[ R_b(N)=R_b(3b-N). \]

Conditional on the accepted graded integral basis \(Q=\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^3}\mathbb Z e_\rho\), \(\deg e_\rho=ij+|\rho|\), one has \[ \operatorname{rank}Q_{ij+N}=R_b(N),\qquad Q_{ij+N}=0\quad(N\notin[0,3b]), \] and every \(Q_{ij+N}\) is free abelian, hence torsion-free.
